scope: security.md §1-§10 + HD-216 + HD-154 + HD-155 + HD-186 + Authentik OIDC + 1P hygiene + live probes
methodology: parent inline execution, read-only, lengths/tails/hashes only for secrets
post_condition: Cloudflare API token rotation incomplete in live traefik — IaC re-render required

findings.title: Cloudflare API token rotation incomplete in live traefik container

evidence.command: ssh vps 'docker exec traefik printenv CF_DNS_API_TOKEN' | sha256sum; op item get cloudflare_api --vault Homelab-ansible --fields credential | sha256sum
evidence.output_snippet: 1P sha256[:16]=56cc7b39dad07d9a (length 53, tail ...4b2d); live sha256[:16]=ab0dea98454dc4c4 (length 53, tail ...45f2) — mismatch, live has OLD value

findings.proposed_fix: re-run bash scripts/ansible-run.sh vps.yml --tags docker_services,traefik (HD-258 bulk pre-pass picks up the new value, HD-260 restart-guard restarts the container on config change); verify via re-hash; journal entry; changelog HD-276

findings.title: Edge WAF coverage: 33/33 traefik routers carry at least one auth tier (security.md §1)

evidence.command: scan templates/docker_services/**/*.{yml,j2} for traefik.http.routers.<name>.middlewares with authentik-forward-auth or crowdsec-only
evidence.output_snippet: 33 routers, 14 with authentik-forward-auth, 11 with crowdsec-only, 1 mixed (onlyoffice), 0 without

findings.title: Stale traefik:v3.5.2 Docker image on VPS (11 months old, not in active use)

evidence.output_snippet: active traefik is v3.7.11 (10 days ago); v3.5.2 is the previous version, no longer used

findings.proposed_fix: ssh vps 'docker image prune -a --filter until=720h' (or weekly cron); HD-284

findings.title: sunshine host port binds 47989-48010 to 0.0.0.0 (should be Home VLAN IP per security.md §3 / HD-62)
findings.proposed_fix: bind to {{ oldsrv_home_ip }}:47989-48010 (mirroring actual-budget pattern); HD-282; Phase 2/3 oldsrv bring-up

findings.title: ollama and immich-ml lack cap_drop: ALL (defense-in-depth; mitigated by network isolation + HD-160 sibling auth)

evidence.output_snippet: ollama: cap_drop ABSENT (needs amdkfd /dev/dri /dev/kfd); immich-ml: cap_drop ABSENT (same); both in ALLOWED_NO_CAP_DROP allowlist (mitigated by overlay isolation)

findings.proposed_fix: add cap_drop: ALL + targeted cap_add (SYS_RAWIO or similar) for amdkfd access; HD-280; verify in test

findings.title: Backup coverage: db-backup on schedule (last 21h ago, 4 DBs), kopia-server connected to Hetzner Storage Box

evidence.command: ssh vps 'docker logs db-backup --tail 5' ; ssh vps 'docker exec kopia-server kopia repository status'
evidence.output_snippet: kopia: Storage type sftp, 1.1 TB available, path kopia, host u653424.your-storagebox.de

findings.title: Bootstrap hygiene: live sshd_config has PasswordAuth no, PermitRootLogin no, MaxAuthTries 3 (HD-208 fix in place)
Sibling auth coverage complete per HD-160 / HD-59 (immich-ml, kopia, openclaw, prometheus, litellm)

evidence.output_snippet: 7/7 data-writing pairs covered; ollama + docling deliberately isolated on overlays

findings.title: Decision log: 6 settled decisions match changelog.md, no re-decide attempts
fail2ban not running on VPS (1d 18h since crash) — http-auth jail points at non-existent traefik access log

evidence.output_snippet: ERROR Failed during configuration: Have not found any log file for http-auth jail

findings.proposed_fix: (a) add traefik accesslog + volume mount for /var/log/traefik/; (b) drop the http-auth jail; (c) write a traefik-aware filter (regex for status=401/403). HD-281. See also SEC-17.

findings.title: wg-s2s WireGuard interface not up on VPS (peer_public_key empty, deploy-gated on Phase 1.5 per HD-03)

evidence.output_snippet: no wg-s2s interface; default wg_s2s_router_public_key is empty (fail-loud at render); HD-03 cutover Phase 1.5 not yet

findings.proposed_fix: phase 1.5 cutover: provision router WG pubkey into VPS vault, run wireguard role; verify blackbox wg_icmp probe via tailnet

findings.title: Capability-tiering on AI stack (HD-247/248/251): public chat.kogler.si uses limited scoped keys, internal ai.kogler.si uses full owner keys
Authentik OIDC posture clean: 22 providers, all confidential (except opencloud public), all 1h tokens; 2 API tokens, 1 ephemeral + 1 persisted with expiring=False (HD-216 satisfied)

evidence.command: ssh vps 'docker exec authentik-server ak shell --no-startup --no-imports' (Python introspection)
evidence.output_snippet: 22 providers; 2 tokens (provision-glue expiring=True in 16min, ak-outpost-...-api expiring=False)

findings.title: 2 duplicate metabase_oidc, items in 1Password (trailing comma in title)

evidence.output_snippet: 2 items named 'metabase_oidc,' (id 57fm6e5etefyfireiy253zmdzi + r7xsh3glxablaaj32zr5grueli); canonical 'metabase_oidc' (id fzw22hqoxzhni3f3hltqrs5ce4) used by IaC

findings.proposed_fix: archive the 2 comma-suffixed items, keep canonical metabase_oidc; HD-283

findings.title: Attack surface: 13/17 public services respond on HTTPS, 4 tailnet-only (expected per HD-273 L3); VPS opens only :22 :80 :443, all other ports loopback or wg-s2s bound

evidence.command: for h in kogler.si sso.kogler.si ...; do curl -sI https://$h; done; ssh vps 'sudo ss -tlnp'
evidence.output_snippet: 13/17 public reachable; 4 tailnet-only 000; VPS opens 22, 80, 443 to 0.0.0.0; everything else loopback (127.0.0.1) or wg-only

findings.title: renovate endpoint is internal (http://forgejo:3000), not the public https://git.kogler.si behind forward-auth (HD-220(c))
grafana↔prometheus auth gap closed (HD-220(b)): datasource carries basicAuthUser + secureJsonData from prometheus-internal_api
fail2ban nginx-http-auth filter is nginx-specific; would not match traefik log format even with accesslog enabled

evidence.output_snippet: filter = nginx-http-auth (regex expects nginx auth_basic log lines; traefik uses its own format with ForwardAuth middleware)

findings.proposed_fix: write a traefik-aware filter (regex for status=401/403 with ForwardAuth); or drop the http-auth jail; HD-281 (related to SEC-9)

findings.title: CrowdSec bouncer configured per HD-87 (plugin enabled, API key wired); live API probe deferred (WSL vantage can't reach 8082 from here)

evidence.output_snippet: CrowdSec bouncer plugin enabled; API key from crowdsec-bouncer_api

findings.proposed_fix: no-op (live probe deferred to LAN-vantage session)
